name: Decorative Hanging Pendant
description:
KEY FEATURES

    - Made from high-quality stainless steel alloy combined with a transparent acrylic cover for enhanced durability and elegant appearance.

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

  • Gift Box:

    - Inner display window: 3.66 × 3.66 in ~ 9.3 × 9.3 cm.

  • Printing Technology:
    - High-quality UV printing on one side of the pendant ensures sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting images.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - A beautiful decorative hanging pendant perfect for displaying meaningful photos or personalized artwork.
    - Ideal for hanging on bags, keychains, backpacks, car mirrors, graduation caps, or decorative spaces.
    - The elegant chain design creates a stylish and eye-catching accessory.
    - Lightweight and compact, making it easy to carry or display anywhere.
    - Serves as both a decorative piece and a meaningful keepsake.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for family, friends, couples, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, graduations, holidays, anniversaries, Halloween, Christmas, or special celebrations.
    - Great as a memory keepsake with photos of loved ones, pets, or special moments.
    - Combines sentimental value with elegant decoration, making it a meaningful and memorable gift. 🎁

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
